final_sql:
SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation Schools'
ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`County Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 
  AND T2.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM frpm 
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(F.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / F.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS Highest_Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm AS F
INNER JOIN satscores AS S ON F.CDSCode = S.cds
WHERE S.NumGE1500 / S.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.District
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.sname,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.sname)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(`School Name`)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador'
  AND `Low Grade` = 9
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT T2.sname
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
  AND (SELECT AVG(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.Street, 
    s.City, 
    s.State, 
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    T1.sname, 
    T1.AvgScrWrite, 
    T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR strftime('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT T2.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = 12
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.SOC = 66
ORDER BY T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
)
SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1) AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2)
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3)
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State
FROM satscores
JOIN schools 
    ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Website
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT s.School,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY st.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT T2.EILName
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sname, 
    AvgScrMath, 
    cname AS County
FROM satscores
WHERE AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.sname, AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite) 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 
ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich') 
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich') 
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich') 
GROUP BY T2.sname;

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Alameda' 
  AND DOC = 52 
  AND OpenDate LIKE '1980%'

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM schools 
   WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' 
     AND County = 'Orange' 
     AND DOC = 54) * 1.0 /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) 
   FROM schools 
   WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' 
     AND County = 'Orange' 
     AND DOC = 52) AS ratio;

SELECT School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT schools.School, schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores s 
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode 
WHERE (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 
  AND sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT SUM(T2.NumTstTakr) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active';

SELECT T3.Phone, T3.Ext
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website 
FROM schools 
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') 
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') 
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Joaquin'
  AND Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE City = 'Hickman' 
  AND Charter = 1 
  AND DOC = 52;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND schools.Charter = 0 
  AND (frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) < 0.18;

SELECT 
    AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
    AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3,
    School,
    City
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' 
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(`Charter Funding Type`) AS Ratio_Percentage
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Santa Clara';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District' 
  AND ClosedDate LIKE '1989%' 
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT 
    County,
    COUNT(*) AS NumberOfClosures
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY NumberOfClosures DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS Active_Schools,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Closed' THEN 1 END) AS Closed_Schools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND SOCType = 'District Community Day School';

SELECT T1.`District Code`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Fresno'
  AND T2.Magnet = 0;

SELECT T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T2.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T1.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015';

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.DOCType = 'Youth Authority School';

SELECT T2.`Low Grade`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NCESDist = '0613360'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON';

SELECT T2.EILName, T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND T1.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT T2.City
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND T1.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND T1.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND T2.EILCode = 'HS';

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'
  AND `County Name` = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`County Name`,
       COUNT(T2.`CDSCode`) AS `num_schools`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2
        ON T1.`CDSCode` = T2.`CDSCode`
WHERE T1.`Virtual` = 'F'
  AND T2.`County Name` IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY T2.`County Name`
ORDER BY `num_schools` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Type`,
    schools.School,
    schools.Latitude
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm 
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY schools.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    s.School,
    f.`Low Grade` AS lowest_grade
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_magnet_K8_multiple_provision
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f
        ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1                      -- offers a magnet program
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'                -- serves Kindergarten to 8th grade
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types';

SELECT Fname AS FirstName,
       District,
       COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM (
        SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District
        FROM schools
        UNION ALL
        SELECT AdmFName2 AS Fname, District
        FROM schools
        UNION ALL
        SELECT AdmFName3 AS Fname, District
        FROM schools
     ) AS all_admins
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Fname, District
ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T2.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, T2.`District Code`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' 
   OR T1.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' 
   OR T1.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54;

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, st.sname AS School_Name
FROM satscores AS st
JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(Id) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND strftime('%Y', CreationDate) > '2013';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS PostCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT T2.DisplayName
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS root_post_count
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM users
INNER JOIN posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId
WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.Age > 65 
  AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM badges 
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';

SELECT T1.DisplayName
FROM users AS T1
JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId
GROUP BY T2.UserId
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM badges AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.Views > 200;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Age > 65 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T2.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts AS T2
JOIN users AS T1 
    ON T2.OwnerUserId = T1.Id
WHERE T2.Score > 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM votes 
WHERE UserId = 58 
  AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19';

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT T1.Title
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId
ORDER BY T2.Score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT posts.FavoriteCount
FROM comments
JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id
WHERE comments.UserId = 3025
  AND comments.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.ParentId = 107829
  AND T2.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT 
    p.Id AS PostId,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'well-finished'
        ELSE 'not well-finished'

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK only)
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID, 
        c.Segment, 
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers tied at the segment minimum: total consumption + their count
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment, 
        SUM(cc.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON cc.Segment = m.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        CAST(total_consumption AS REAL) / num_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') 
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') 
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')

            M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11

),

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- For each bond, get the elements of its two atoms
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
                THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
                ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
           END AS element_combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds have each element combination
    SELECT element_combo, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element_combo
)
-- Percentage = (bonds with the most common combo) / (total bonds) * 100
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    AND b.bond_type = '='
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       b.molecule_id,
       a1.atom_id    AS atom_1,
       a1.element    AS atom_1_element,
       a2.atom_id    AS atom_2,
       a2.element    AS atom_2_element
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
     ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1
     ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
     ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
     FROM bond
     WHERE bond_type = '=')                                          AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE b.bond_type = '='
       AND m.label = '+')                                            AS carcinogenic_molecules;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'cl' 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
       / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1' 
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.molecule_id
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_atoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) 
FROM bond 
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010' 
  AND bond_type = '-';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b 
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) 
FROM bond b 
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b 
  ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND T3.bond_type = '='
  AND T4.label = 'TR012';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'o';
SELECT MAX("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Eligible Free Rate"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = 66
ORDER BY "Eligible Free Rate" ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F'
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT satscores.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)") FROM frpm)

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.NumTstTakr, 0) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT T2.NCESSchool
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY avg_reading DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rnk
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.County = 'Fresno' AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND satscores.NumTstTakr <= 250

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' AND `Low Grade` = '9' AND `High Grade` = '12'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.StreetAbr, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30

SELECT satscores.sname
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND satscores.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T1.School, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Riverside' AND T2.rtype = 'S'
GROUP BY T1.School, T1.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T2.GSserved = '9-12'

SELECT sa.sname, sa.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / "Enrollment (K-12)") AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM frpm
    ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
)

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.SOC = 66 AND frpm.`Low Grade` = 1 AND frpm.`High Grade` = 12 ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1, AdmFName2, AdmLName2, AdmFName3, AdmLName3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
GROUP BY t.cds, s.Website
HAVING SUM(t.NumTstTakr) BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT s.School,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sc
    JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) t
WHERE rnk <= 5
SELECT schools.EILName FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AvgScrMath, cname FROM satscores ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOC = 52 AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange' AND DOC IN (52, 54)

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )

SELECT schools.MailStreet, satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'
SELECT School, MailZip FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian' OR AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian' OR AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 END) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT Phone, Ext
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332
)
SELECT Phone, Ext, School FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson' AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18
SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1, AdmFName2, AdmLName2, AdmFName3, AdmLName3, School, City FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(FundingType) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE County = 'Santa Clara' AND FundingType IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2005-12-31 23:59:59'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District' AND ClosedDate LIKE '1989%' AND City = 'San Francisco'

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'District Community Day School' AND County = 'Alpine' AND StatusType = 'Active' UNION SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'District Community Day School' AND County = 'Alpine' AND StatusType = 'Closed'
SELECT `frpm`.`District Code` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON `frpm`.`CDSCode` = `schools`.`CDSCode` WHERE `schools`.`City` = 'Fresno' AND `schools`.`Magnet` = 0

SELECT f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'

SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T2.SOCType = 'Youth Authority School'
SELECT frpm."Low Grade" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.NCESDist = '0613360' AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
SELECT T2.EILName, T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`County Code` = 37 AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
SELECT s.City FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = '2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND s.County = 'Merced' AND s.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS NumSchools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY NumSchools DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SOCType, School, Latitude FROM schools ORDER BY Latitude DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN schools.CDSCode ELSE NULL END) AS num_of_schools_offering_multiple_provision_types, schools.City, COUNT(schools.CDSCode) AS num_of_schools
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1 AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY schools.City

SELECT t.name, s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT AdmFName1 AS name FROM schools
        UNION ALL
        SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools
        UNION ALL
        SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools
    )
    WHERE name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
) t ON s.AdmFName1 = t.name OR s.AdmFName2 = t.name OR s.AdmFName3 = t.name

SELECT T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", T1."District Code"
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
SELECT AdmLName1, District, County, School FROM schools WHERE CharterNum = '40'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND AdmEmail1 LIKE '%@%'
  AND AdmEmail2 LIKE '%@%'
  AND AdmEmail3 LIKE '%@%'
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
GROUP BY DisplayName
HAVING MAX(Reputation) = (

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minima m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH per_segment AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_totals AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM totals t
  JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT segment
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient' ELSE 'outpatient' END,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
tot AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk c
    JOIN tot t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk c
    JOIN tot t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN mins m ON m.Segment = c.Segment AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH cons AS (
  SELECT customers.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN yearmonth.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN yearmonth.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth
  JOIN customers ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
  WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND customers.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY customers.Segment
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'Biggest' AS Which, Segment, ROUND((c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013, 2) AS Percentage
  FROM cons
  ORDER BY 3 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1);

JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT ((SELECT T1.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes T1
         JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
         WHERE T2.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
           AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
        -
        (SELECT T1.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes T1
         JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
         WHERE T2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
           AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'))
       * 1.0
       / (SELECT T1.overall_rating
          FROM Player_Attributes T1
          JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
          WHERE T2.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
            AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
       * 100 AS percentage_higher;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DISTINCT player_name FROM Player WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
      M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
      M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11
  )
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_name)
       FROM Player AS p
       WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
         AND p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3,
                                 m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
                                 m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
                                 m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)) = 2;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
    )
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) <= 30
);

    SELECT home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
           home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,

           away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8, away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11

    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')

italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
start_bal AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
end_bal AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM end_bal) - (SELECT balance FROM start_bal)) * 100.0
       / (SELECT balance FROM start_bal) AS balance_increase_rate;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount), 2) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

  AND (CASE WHEN LENGTH(a.date) = 6 THEN 1900 + CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) END) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

JOIN disp ON l.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
  SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
  FROM customer_totals ct
  JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
  GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct);

FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

SELECT D.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T.A11 AS gap
FROM (
    SELECT C.client_id, DIST.A11
    FROM client C
    JOIN district DIST ON C.district_id = DIST.district_id
    WHERE C.gender = 'F'
      AND C.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
    ORDER BY DIST.A11 ASC
    LIMIT 1
) T
JOIN disp D ON D.client_id = T.client_id
ORDER BY D.account_id;

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND district.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND disp.type = 'Owner';

WHERE l.status = 'A'

      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.status = 'A'

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) AS total_lowest,
           COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS cnt
    FROM per_customer p
    WHERE p.total_consumption = (
        SELECT MIN(q.total_consumption)
        FROM per_customer q
        WHERE q.Segment = p.Segment
    )
    GROUP BY p.Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_lowest * 1.0 / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_per_segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncreaseSegment,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncreaseSegment;

WITH female_sal AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11 AS salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT MIN(salary) AS min_salary FROM female_sal
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT fs.client_id
    FROM female_sal fs, lowest
    WHERE fs.salary = lowest.min_salary
      AND fs.birth_date = (
          SELECT MAX(fs2.birth_date)
          FROM female_sal fs2, lowest
          WHERE fs2.salary = lowest.min_salary
      )
)
SELECT disp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - lowest.min_salary AS gap
FROM oldest
JOIN disp ON oldest.client_id = disp.client_id
CROSS JOIN lowest;

JOIN colour AS c ON T1.eye_colour_id = c.id

FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id

FROM gender g
JOIN superhero s ON s.gender_id = g.id

WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')

      SELECT MAX(weight_kg)
      FROM superhero
      WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')
  );

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'

      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)

      JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON s2.id = ha2.hero_id

SELECT T1.bond_id, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3'
UNION
SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'
SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';
SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c');
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'n' AND molecule.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND m.label = 'TR024'
SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a1.molecule_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND a1.element = 'h' AND a2.element = 'h'
);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-' AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008' AND element = 'c';
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT T1.element, T2.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' AND m.label = 'TR012';
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AND element = 'o'

FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda'

SELECT s.School,
       f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = 67
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1

LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Phone

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)

SELECT DISTINCT s.School

SELECT schools.Phone

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)

SELECT s.City

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) AS seg_total, COUNT(*) AS cust_count
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN seg_total * 1.0 / cust_count END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN seg_total * 1.0 / cust_count END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN seg_total * 1.0 / cust_count END) AS kam_avg
    FROM least
)
SELECT
    sme_avg - lam_avg AS diff_SME_LAM,
    lam_avg - kam_avg AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    kam_avg - sme_avg AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avgs;

           ) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_change
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

FROM pct

UNION ALL

SELECT CASE a.element
         WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
         WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
         WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
         WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
         WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
         WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
         WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
         WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
         WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
         WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
    ) t
    JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
        FROM (
            SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
            FROM yearmonth y
            JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
            WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
        ) x
        GROUP BY Segment
    ) m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
) a

SELECT (
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
   JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
   WHERE P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
   LIMIT 1)
  -
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
   JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
   WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   LIMIT 1)
) * 100.0 /
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes AS PA

   WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'

    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,

SELECT p.player_name, c.name AS country, MAX(pa.vision) AS vision
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89
GROUP BY p.player_name, c.name
ORDER BY vision DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id LEFT JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' AND loan.account_id IS NULL
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(client.client_id) FROM client INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
  AND c.birth_date = (
      SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date)
      FROM client c2
      WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
        AND c2.district_id IN (
            SELECT district_id FROM district
            WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
        )
  )

SELECT DISTINCT T4.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN account AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T2.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) FROM client JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND disp.type = 'Owner'

SELECT client.client_id FROM client JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE disp.type = 'DISPONENT' AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

FROM loan

WHERE loan.status = 'A'
  AND loan.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY loan.amount ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM loan

  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1993'

LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(client.client_id) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT account.account_id, MIN(trans.date) AS earliest_date

JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.date >= '1995-01-01' AND trans.date < '1996-01-01'

SELECT account.district_id

SELECT MAX(T4.amount) FROM card AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.issued = '1996-10-21'

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t

LIMIT 1

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS t
    JOIN segment_min AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT 'Biggest' AS Type, Segment, pct FROM (

         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -

          SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
  ORDER BY pct DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
